description: Set up and run a community management program from guidelines through engagement tracking.

steps.description: Draft community guidelines and moderation rules.

inputs.name: community-purpose
inputs.desc: The purpose and target audience of the community

inputs.name: platform-choice
inputs.desc: The platform for the community (Discord, Slack, Facebook Group, Reddit)

outputs.name: community-guidelines
outputs.desc: Published guidelines and code of conduct

outputs.name: moderation-rules
outputs.desc: Rules for content removal, warnings, and bans

process: Define the community's purpose and who it serves.
Write the behavior standards (what is welcome, what is not).
Set the enforcement ladder (warning, mute, temporary ban, permanent ban).
Format the guidelines for posting in the community's welcome channel or pinned post.

steps.description: Design the onboarding flow for new community members.

inputs.name: platform-choice
inputs.desc: The platform the community runs on

outputs.name: onboarding-flow
outputs.desc: Step-by-step flow a new member goes through on joining

outputs.name: welcome-content
outputs.desc: Welcome message, introduction prompts, and resource links

process: Map the new member journey from join to first interaction.
Write the welcome message and introduction prompt.
List the key channels or sections to direct new members to.
Set up any role assignment or verification steps.

steps.description: Plan the content and engagement activities for the community.

inputs.name: onboarding-flow
inputs.desc: The onboarding flow for context on member journey

outputs.name: content-calendar
outputs.desc: Weekly schedule of community content and activities

outputs.name: engagement-tactics
outputs.desc: List of recurring engagement activities (AMAs, polls, challenges, discussions)

process: Identify the content themes that serve the community's purpose.
Schedule recurring activities (weekly discussion threads, monthly AMAs, challenges).
Plan spontaneous engagement tactics (polls, questions of the day).
Assign content creation responsibilities and deadlines.

steps.description: Set up the moderation protocol and tools.

inputs.name: moderation-rules
inputs.desc: The moderation rules from the guidelines

inputs.name: platform-choice
inputs.desc: The platform the community runs on

outputs.name: moderation-protocol
outputs.desc: Step-by-step protocol for handling violations

outputs.name: moderation-tools-config
outputs.desc: Configuration for bots, filters, and reporting workflows

process: Map each violation type to a specific response action.
Configure automated filters for spam, slurs, and prohibited content.
Set up the reporting workflow (how members report, how moderators triage).
Document the escalation path for edge cases.

steps.description: Track community health metrics and produce the management report.

outputs.name: health-metrics
outputs.desc: Metrics on growth, engagement rate, retention, and moderation actions

outputs.name: community-management-plan
outputs.desc: The complete community management plan document

process: Define the metrics to track (member growth, active members, posts per day, engagement rate, churn).
Set up the data collection method for each metric.
Establish the review cadence (weekly health check, monthly deep dive).
Compile the full community management plan from all prior outputs.

description: Set up social listening from keyword definition through trend analysis.

steps.description: Define the keywords and topics to monitor across social channels.

inputs.name: brand-name
inputs.desc: The brand or product name to monitor

outputs.name: keyword-list
outputs.desc: Organized list of keywords by category (brand, competitor, industry)

outputs.name: boolean-queries
outputs.desc: Search queries formatted for monitoring tools

process: List all brand name variations, misspellings, and abbreviations.
List competitor brand names and product names.
Add industry terms, trending hashtags, and relevant phrases.
Format each group into boolean search queries for the monitoring tool.

steps.description: Select and configure the channels to monitor.

outputs.name: channel-configuration
outputs.desc: List of channels to monitor with access and configuration details

outputs.name: alert-rules
outputs.desc: Alert triggers for volume spikes or sentiment shifts

process: Identify which channels matter for this brand (Twitter/X, Reddit, forums, review sites, news, LinkedIn).
Configure monitoring on each selected channel.
Set alert thresholds for mention volume spikes (e.g., 3x normal daily volume).
Set sentiment shift alerts (e.g., negative mentions exceed 30% of total).

steps.description: Categorize incoming mentions by theme and sentiment.

outputs.name: mention-categories
outputs.desc: Taxonomy of mention themes (product feedback, complaints, praise, feature requests, competitor mentions)

outputs.name: sentiment-baseline
outputs.desc: Baseline sentiment distribution to measure changes against

process: Define the mention categories (product feedback, complaint, praise, feature request, competitor comparison, general).
Classify a sample of recent mentions to establish the baseline distribution.
Calculate the baseline sentiment split (positive, neutral, negative).
Document the categorization rules for consistent tagging.

steps.description: Analyze trends from social listening data and produce the report.

outputs.name: trend-analysis
outputs.desc: Weekly trend analysis showing volume changes, emerging themes, and sentiment shifts

outputs.name: social-listening-report
outputs.desc: The complete social listening report with findings and recommendations

process: Compare current week mention volume against the prior period and baseline.
Identify emerging themes or topics gaining traction.
Flag any sentiment shifts that cross the alert thresholds.
Summarize findings and recommend actions in the social listening report.

description: Run an influencer collaboration from identification through performance tracking.

steps.description: Define the campaign goals, audience, and influencer criteria.

inputs.name: campaign-goals
inputs.desc: What the campaign should achieve (awareness, traffic, conversions)

inputs.name: target-audience
inputs.desc: The audience the campaign should reach

inputs.name: campaign-budget
inputs.desc: The available budget for influencer partnerships

outputs.name: campaign-brief
outputs.desc: The campaign brief with goals, audience, timeline, and key messages

outputs.name: influencer-criteria
outputs.desc: Selection criteria (follower range, engagement rate, audience demographics, content style)

process: State the campaign goal in measurable terms (e.g., 10,000 impressions, 500 clicks, 50 conversions).
Define the target audience demographics and interests.
Set the influencer selection criteria (minimum engagement rate, audience overlap, content alignment).
Write the campaign brief with timeline and key messages.

steps.description: Identify and vet potential influencers against the criteria.

outputs.name: influencer-shortlist
outputs.desc: Vetted list of influencers with reach, engagement rate, audience demographics, and fit score

outputs.name: vetting-notes
outputs.desc: Notes on each candidate including past brand work, content quality, and any red flags

process: Search for influencers matching the criteria on the target platforms.
Score each candidate on reach, engagement rate, audience demographics, and content alignment.
Check past brand collaborations and any controversial content.
Rank the candidates and produce the shortlist with vetting notes.

steps.description: Negotiate terms and deliverables with selected influencers.

outputs.name: partnership-agreements
outputs.desc: Signed or agreed terms for each influencer (deliverables, timeline, compensation, usage rights)

outputs.name: content-briefs
outputs.desc: Individual content briefs for each influencer

process: Contact each influencer on the shortlist with the campaign brief.
Negotiate deliverables (number of posts, formats, platforms), compensation, and timeline.
Agree on content usage rights and exclusivity terms.
Finalize the partnership agreement and send individual content briefs.

steps.description: Review and approve influencer content before publication.

inputs.name: content-briefs
inputs.desc: The content briefs sent to influencers

outputs.name: approved-content
outputs.desc: Content approved for publication with any revision notes

outputs.name: publication-schedule
outputs.desc: The publication schedule for all influencer posts

process: Receive draft content from each influencer.
Review for brand alignment, messaging accuracy, and disclosure compliance (FTC guidelines).
Request revisions if needed and re-review.
Approve final content and confirm the publication dates.

steps.description: Track campaign performance and produce the report.

outputs.name: performance-data
outputs.desc: Performance data per influencer (reach, engagement, clicks, conversions)

outputs.name: influencer-campaign-report
outputs.desc: The complete campaign report with ROI analysis and lessons learned

process: Collect performance data for each published post (reach, impressions, engagement, clicks, conversions).
Calculate the cost per engagement and cost per conversion for each influencer.
Compare results against the campaign goals set in the brief.
Compile the campaign report with ROI analysis and recommendations for future campaigns.

description: Build and run a user-generated content program from collection through distribution.

steps.description: Define the UGC types to collect and the collection channels.

inputs.name: brand-context
inputs.desc: The brand, product, or service the UGC is for

inputs.name: marketing-goals
inputs.desc: What the UGC program should achieve (social proof, engagement, content volume)

outputs.name: ugc-types
outputs.desc: Defined types of UGC to collect (reviews, photos, videos, testimonials, unboxing)

outputs.name: collection-channels
outputs.desc: Channels and mechanisms for collecting UGC (hashtags, submission forms, contests, review prompts)

process: Identify which UGC types best serve the marketing goals.
Select the collection mechanisms for each type (branded hashtag, landing page form, email prompt, in-app prompt).
Design any incentive structure (contests, features, discounts).
Document the collection strategy.

steps.description: Establish the rights and permissions framework for using submitted content.

inputs.name: ugc-types
inputs.desc: The types of UGC being collected

outputs.name: rights-framework
outputs.desc: Terms of use, permission request templates, and consent tracking process

outputs.name: legal-guidelines
outputs.desc: Guidelines on attribution, usage scope, and duration of rights

process: Draft the terms of use that contributors agree to when submitting.
Create permission request templates for content found organically (not submitted directly).
Set up the consent tracking system (who granted what, when).
Document attribution requirements and usage scope.

steps.description: Curate and approve submitted content for use.

inputs.name: ugc-types
inputs.desc: The types of UGC being collected

outputs.name: curated-content-library
outputs.desc: Approved UGC organized by type, theme, and quality tier

outputs.name: rejection-log
outputs.desc: Log of rejected content with reasons

process: Review incoming submissions against brand standards and quality criteria.
Verify that rights and permissions are in place for each piece.
Tag and categorize approved content by type, theme, and quality tier.
Log rejected content with the reason for rejection.

steps.description: Distribute UGC across marketing channels and track performance.

outputs.name: distribution-plan
outputs.desc: Schedule of UGC placements across channels (social, website, email, ads)

outputs.name: ugc-program-plan
outputs.desc: The complete UGC program plan with metrics and review cadence

process: Map each UGC piece to the channels where it will be used (social posts, website galleries, email campaigns, ad creative).
Schedule the placements and set the attribution (creator credit).
Define the metrics to track (engagement on UGC vs. brand content, submission volume, conversion impact).
Compile the full UGC program plan.

description: Respond to a social media crisis from detection through post-incident review.

steps.description: Detect and assess a social media crisis.

inputs.name: alert-trigger
inputs.desc: The alert or observation that flagged the potential crisis

inputs.name: brand-context
inputs.desc: The brand and its current social media presence

outputs.name: crisis-assessment
outputs.desc: Assessment of severity (low, medium, high, critical), scope, and velocity of spread

outputs.name: affected-channels
outputs.desc: List of channels where the crisis is active

process: Review the alert trigger and verify it is a real crisis, not normal noise.
Measure the current volume and velocity (how fast mentions are growing).
Assess the sentiment and identify the key complaint or issue.
Classify the severity level and list the affected channels.

steps.description: Draft the response messaging and activate the response team.

outputs.name: response-messages
outputs.desc: Approved response messages for each channel

outputs.name: response-team-assignments
outputs.desc: Who is handling which channel and responsibility

process: Assemble the response team (social, PR, legal, product as needed).
Draft the initial response (acknowledge, empathize, state next steps).
Adapt the message for each affected channel's format and tone.
Get approval from the necessary stakeholders before publishing.

steps.description: Publish the response and manage ongoing communication.

outputs.name: publication-log
outputs.desc: Log of all published responses with timestamps and channels

outputs.name: follow-up-plan
outputs.desc: Plan for ongoing updates and individual response handling

process: Publish the approved response on all affected channels.
Begin responding to individual comments and messages using the approved messaging.
Post updates as the situation develops.
Log every published response with timestamp and channel.

steps.description: Monitor the aftermath and produce the crisis response report.

inputs.name: crisis-assessment
inputs.desc: The initial crisis assessment for comparison

outputs.name: aftermath-analysis
outputs.desc: Analysis of sentiment recovery, mention volume decline, and audience reaction to the response

outputs.name: crisis-response-report
outputs.desc: The complete crisis response report with timeline, actions, outcomes, and lessons learned

process: Monitor mention volume and sentiment for 48 to 72 hours post-response.
Track whether the response resolved the issue or escalated it.
Compile the full timeline from detection through resolution.
Document lessons learned and updates needed for the crisis playbook.

description: Set up and optimize a business social media presence across platforms.

steps.description: Audit existing social media accounts across platforms.

inputs.name: target-platforms
inputs.desc: Platforms to set up or audit (Instagram, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube)

outputs.name: account-inventory
outputs.desc: Inventory of existing accounts with status (active, inactive, unclaimed, duplicate)

outputs.name: gap-list
outputs.desc: Platforms where accounts are missing or incomplete

process: Search each target platform for existing accounts using the business name and variations.
Document each account found (URL, status, follower count, last activity date).
Identify duplicate or unauthorized accounts.
List the platforms where accounts need to be created or claimed.

steps.description: Create or optimize profiles on each platform.

outputs.name: optimized-profiles
outputs.desc: Profile details for each platform (bio, profile image, cover image, links, CTA)

outputs.name: brand-consistency-checklist
outputs.desc: Checklist confirming visual and messaging consistency across platforms

process: Create accounts on platforms in the gap list.
Write the bio for each platform, adapted to its character limit and tone.
Set the profile image, cover image, and brand colors consistently.
Add the website link, contact information, and call-to-action on each.

steps.description: Set up admin access, business tools, and analytics tracking.

outputs.name: admin-configuration
outputs.desc: Admin roles, business manager setup, and security settings for each platform

outputs.name: analytics-configuration
outputs.desc: Analytics and tracking setup for each platform

process: Set up business manager or creator studio access on each platform.
Assign admin roles and permissions to team members.
Enable two-factor authentication and review security settings.
Configure native analytics and connect any third-party tracking tools.

steps.description: Produce the final account setup checklist and documentation.

outputs.name: account-setup-checklist
outputs.desc: Completed checklist covering all platforms with credentials, access, and configuration details

outputs.name: platform-documentation
outputs.desc: Documentation of each account's settings and access for the team

process: Verify all accounts are live, optimized, and accessible by the team.
Compile the credentials and access documentation (securely stored).
Produce the setup checklist confirming every platform is configured.
Schedule the first content posts or launch campaign.

description: Conduct a periodic social media analytics review from data collection through recommendations.

steps.description: Collect performance data across all social platforms.

inputs.name: platforms-list
inputs.desc: The social platforms to pull data from

inputs.name: review-period
inputs.desc: The time period to analyze (e.g., last 30 days, last quarter)

outputs.name: raw-performance-data
outputs.desc: Performance data per platform (reach, impressions, engagement, followers, clicks, conversions)

outputs.name: prior-period-data
outputs.desc: The same metrics from the prior period for comparison

process: Pull performance metrics from each platform's native analytics.
Collect the same metrics for the prior comparison period.
Normalize the data into a consistent format across platforms.
Flag any data gaps or anomalies.

steps.description: Analyze performance data and identify trends.

outputs.name: performance-analysis
outputs.desc: Analysis of changes in reach, engagement, follower growth, and conversion rates

outputs.name: content-rankings
outputs.desc: Top and bottom performing content with identified patterns

process: Calculate period-over-period changes for each metric.
Rank content by engagement rate and reach to identify top and bottom performers.
Identify patterns in top-performing content (format, topic, time of day, platform).
Note any external factors that may have influenced performance.

steps.description: Analyze audience demographics and behavior patterns.

inputs.name: raw-performance-data
inputs.desc: The performance data including audience metrics

outputs.name: audience-insights
outputs.desc: Demographics, active times, content preferences, and engagement patterns of the audience

outputs.name: audience-growth-analysis
outputs.desc: Analysis of follower growth sources and churn

process: Review audience demographics (age, gender, location, interests) on each platform.
Identify peak activity times and days for the audience.
Analyze which content types and topics drive the most audience interaction.
Track follower growth and identify where new followers are coming from.

steps.description: Produce the analytics report with recommendations.

outputs.name: analytics-report
outputs.desc: The complete analytics report with metrics, trends, and recommendations

outputs.name: action-items
outputs.desc: Specific adjustments to make in the next period (content mix, posting times, platform focus)

process: Summarize the key metrics and period-over-period changes.
Highlight the top findings (what worked, what did not, what changed).
Recommend specific adjustments to content strategy, posting schedule, and platform allocation.
List the action items with owners and deadlines.

description: Build a hashtag strategy from research through performance testing.

steps.description: Research relevant hashtags by category.

inputs.name: industry-niche
inputs.desc: The industry or niche the brand operates in

inputs.name: target-platforms
inputs.desc: The platforms where hashtags will be used

outputs.name: hashtag-candidates
outputs.desc: List of candidate hashtags organized by category (branded, campaign, community, trending, niche)

outputs.name: volume-data
outputs.desc: Post volume and competition level for each candidate hashtag

process: Generate branded hashtag candidates (brand name, tagline, campaign names).
Research community and niche hashtags used by the target audience.
Identify trending and seasonal hashtags relevant to the industry.
Pull volume and competition data for each candidate.

steps.description: Select and organize hashtag sets for each content type.

outputs.name: hashtag-sets
outputs.desc: Curated hashtag sets for each content type (product posts, educational, behind-the-scenes, promotional)

outputs.name: usage-guidelines
outputs.desc: Guidelines on how many hashtags to use per platform and content type

process: Select the best hashtags from each category based on volume, competition, and relevance.
Group them into sets by content type (e.g., product launch set, educational set, engagement set).
Set the hashtag count per platform (e.g., 3 to 5 for Twitter/X, 10 to 20 for Instagram).
Write the usage guidelines for the team.

steps.description: Test hashtag performance and refine the strategy.

outputs.name: test-results
outputs.desc: Performance data for each hashtag set over the trial period (reach, impressions, engagement)

outputs.name: hashtag-strategy-document
outputs.desc: The final hashtag strategy with recommended sets, usage rules, and review cadence

process: Run each hashtag set on a sample of posts over a 2 to 4 week trial.
Track reach and engagement for posts using each set versus posts without.
Identify the top-performing and underperforming hashtags.
Finalize the hashtag strategy document with the proven sets and a quarterly review schedule.

description: Repurpose existing content across social platforms from audit through performance tracking.

steps.description: Audit existing content assets for repurposing potential.

inputs.name: content-inventory
inputs.desc: List of existing content assets (blog posts, videos, podcasts, webinars, whitepapers)

inputs.name: target-platforms
inputs.desc: The social platforms to repurpose content for

outputs.name: repurposing-candidates
outputs.desc: Ranked list of content assets with the highest repurposing potential

outputs.name: format-matrix
outputs.desc: Matrix mapping each candidate to the formats it can become on each platform

process: Score each content asset on performance (traffic, engagement, shares), evergreen value, and adaptability.
Rank assets by repurposing potential.
For each top candidate, identify the formats it can become (carousel, short video, thread, infographic, quote card, story).
Produce the format matrix mapping content to platform-specific formats.

steps.description: Adapt content for each target platform's format and requirements.

inputs.name: repurposing-candidates
inputs.desc: The top content assets to repurpose

outputs.name: adapted-content
outputs.desc: Repurposed content pieces ready for each platform (text, images, video clips, carousels)

outputs.name: adaptation-notes
outputs.desc: Notes on what was changed for each platform (length, aspect ratio, tone, CTA)

process: For each content piece, adapt the text to the platform's tone and character limits.
Resize or reformat visuals for the platform's aspect ratio and specifications.
Add platform-specific elements (hashtags, tags, captions, alt text).
Quality check each adapted piece for accuracy and brand consistency.

steps.description: Schedule the repurposed content and track performance.

outputs.name: publishing-schedule
outputs.desc: Schedule of repurposed content across platforms with dates and times

outputs.name: repurposing-plan
outputs.desc: The complete repurposing plan with cadence, metrics, and review schedule

process: Schedule each piece on the appropriate platform at the optimal posting time.
Space out repurposed content to avoid flooding any single channel.
Define the metrics to compare repurposed content against original (engagement, reach, cost per piece).
Compile the repurposing plan with the review cadence.

description: Manage online reputation from audit through sentiment tracking.

steps.description: Audit current reviews and mentions across platforms.

inputs.name: review-platforms
inputs.desc: Platforms to audit (Google, Yelp, Glassdoor, Trustpilot, social media, industry-specific sites)

outputs.name: reputation-snapshot
outputs.desc: Current ratings, review counts, and sentiment breakdown across all platforms

outputs.name: critical-reviews
outputs.desc: List of unanswered or critical reviews requiring immediate attention

process: Pull the current rating and review count from each platform.
Categorize reviews by sentiment (positive, neutral, negative).
Identify unanswered reviews, especially negative ones.
Produce the reputation snapshot with platform-by-platform breakdown.

steps.description: Design the review response protocol.

outputs.name: response-protocol
outputs.desc: Response protocol for positive, negative, and neutral reviews with templates and SLA

outputs.name: escalation-rules
outputs.desc: Rules for escalating reviews to management, legal, or PR

process: Write response templates for positive reviews (thank, personalize, invite back).
Write response templates for negative reviews (acknowledge, empathize, offer resolution).
Set the response SLA (e.g., respond within 24 hours for negative, 48 hours for positive).
Define escalation triggers (legal threats, viral reviews, factual disputes).

steps.description: Set up ongoing review monitoring and alerts.

outputs.name: monitoring-configuration
outputs.desc: Monitoring setup with alert rules for new reviews

outputs.name: assignment-rules
outputs.desc: Rules for assigning reviews to team members for response

process: Configure alerts for new reviews on each platform.
Set up automatic routing of reviews to the assigned team member.
Configure priority alerts for negative reviews or reviews mentioning specific issues.
Test the monitoring and alert pipeline.

steps.description: Track reputation trends and produce the management report.

outputs.name: sentiment-trends
outputs.desc: Trends in rating, review volume, and sentiment over time

outputs.name: reputation-management-report
outputs.desc: The complete reputation management report with trends, response metrics, and recommendations

process: Track rating changes and review volume month over month.
Measure response rate and average response time against the SLA.
Identify recurring themes in negative reviews for product or service improvement.
Compile the reputation management report with trends and action items.
